features.title: A summary footer under each finished turn
features.summary: Under each finished turn, one line says what the agent did with tools: files edited with lines added and removed, commands run, tests passed out of total from the last test-runner summary, files read and searches, and how long the turn took — "Edited 3 files +42 −7 · ran 6 commands · 1 failed · tests 40/42 · 1m 12s". The file count opens the edited files (each opens in the editor), the command count opens every command with its outcome, and the red failure count opens the failed commands with how each ended (exit code, signal, or a call the tool rejected). Each part can be switched off.

Boolean; show how long the turn took from its start to its end.

failureModes: A turn whose tool calls fell outside the loaded history summarises only the calls still loaded.
The summary sits under the turn, not in each "Ran commands" group header: the Host draws that header with no plugin seam.
Line counts come from the edit calls' arguments: a write counts its whole content as added because the file it replaced is not in the call.
Test counts read only the last Vitest, Jest or pytest summary line a command printed in the turn.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the summary footer renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: A walkthrough under a turn that changed code
features.summary: Under a finished turn that edited files, one row opens a walkthrough: the changed files grouped by folder, each folder with a one-line summary ("Edited 2 files · +40 −3"), and every file row opens that file in the editor. Review in Changes opens that turn's changed-files review in the right pane (the Changes facet when pulls-review is loaded, else the native review tab). It is a row in the turn footer, so a closed walkthrough never floats above the composer.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task*" "[[call write {\"file_path\":\"notes/walkthrough.md\",\"content\":\"one two\"}]]"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the walkthrough row after a turn that edited files.

failureModes: Review in Changes appears only once the Host has summarized the turn's changed files (its workspace/changes event); a turn from an older Host has no link.
The link opens in the right pane of the thread on screen; in a split layout it follows the pane's mounted thread.
